blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Monday said that the testimony that will be provided by the president of Samchan Foreign Exchange Corporation will be important in the resolution of the P7.4-billion plunder case of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez, as it stressed the role of the foreign exchange in the financial transactions. Assistant Ombudsman Mico Clavano made this statement as Felicito Guevarra surrendered to the National Bureau of Investigation last Thursday after the prosecutors moved to cancel his passport.
